image_description: A top-down view of two disposable lighters placed on a light-colored wooden surface. The lighter on the left is upright, featuring a translucent grey plastic body, a black collar, and a silver metal wind guard with an active flame emerging from the nozzle. The lighter on the right lies flat, showing its back side which has a faded blueish-grey plastic casing and faint, illegible text printed near the bottom.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom center of the image, between the two lighters
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of characters ('0 zver...') that appears to be AI-generated hallucinated text or a corrupted watermark. It is legible as text-like structures but semantically meaningless and visually inconsistent with a natural label.
The surface of the right lighter has a slightly 'waxy' or smeared appearance compared to the sharper details of the left lighter, lacking the crisp specular highlights expected on smooth plastic.
The connection between the metal wind guard and the plastic collar is slightly indistinct, with some edge bleeding, though not structurally impossible.
